messages:
jordan (infosec): Vendor just confirmed pen-test kickoff next Tue. Scope explicitly calls out RBAC change attempts, KMS integration checks, audit-log tampering tests, and vuln-exfil scenarios. Need intake checklist filled + staging access by EOD Fri. Who can own remediation tracking?

mira (eng-security): I can own tracking. Quick Qs: vendor name, IP ranges for pentest VMs, and do we allow DB snapshots or only read-only queries? Also we need an evidence bucket path and an ephemeral creds plan.

alex (platform): Vendor = RedTeamCo. IP ranges: 54.162.0.0/16 and 18.202.0.0/16 (I’ll whitelist in staging firewall). DB snapshots: allowed as read-only, must be scrubbed for PII first — prefer export of anonymized tables.

sam (sre): Egress logging needs to be on (all egress flows) and flow logs exported to the evidence bucket. We should also enable packet capture for a rolling 6 hour window during active testing.

pen-test-bot: Created ticket SEC-4892 and scheduled initial recon window. Link: https://jira.redwood/SEC-4892 :white_check_mark:

mira (eng-security): For RBAC: we will create an ephemeral role 'pt_reader' scoped to staging project with least-priv. Example IAM snippet below for the onboarding script — pls review before I apply:

```
# create ephemeral role and grant to vendor service account
gcloud iam roles create ptReader --project=redwood-staging \
  --title="PenTest Reader" \
  --permissions="logging.logEntries.list,logging.logEntries.get,cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get" 
# bind
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-staging \
  --member="serviceAccount:redteamco-sa@redteamco.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="projects/redwood-staging/roles/ptReader"
```

mira (eng-security): Important: do NOT grant cloudkms.cryptoKeys.encrypt/decrypt on production keys. For KMS tests we will create a staging test key (CMEK) and let vendor use wrapped-key APIs only. KMS team, can you create a test HSM-backed key and enable CMEK for the test bucket?

alex (platform): KMS team: done. Created key ring `pt-keyring-staging` and key `pt-test-key-hsm`. I will not give raw key material; vendor can call cloudkms.asymmetricEncrypt with the key (wrapped key flow). We will rotate the key after retest.

anya (product): Quick prod-safety check: confirm no prod network, no secret material in evidence, and that we have product SME available for quick clarifications during remediation.

jordan (infosec): Confirmed — no prod access. Evidence bucket: gs://redwood-pt-evidence/SEC-4892/. Please use that path and the ephemeral creds created per the onboarding ticket. Reminder: scrub screenshots for tokens/API keys before uploading.

mira (eng-security): Audit logging: we need 90 days of immutable export for all admin/audit logs during the engagement. Export command (example):

```
# export admin/audit logs to evidence bucket
gcloud logging sinks create sec4892-sink storage.googleapis.com/redwood-pt-evidence --log-filter="logName:admin AND resource.type=project" --project=redwood-staging
gsutil acl ch -u redteamco-sa@redteamco.iam.gserviceaccount.com:R gs://redwood-pt-evidence/SEC-4892/
```

sam (sre): Also enable Cloud NAT logs + egress ip mapping. I’ll provision a 6-hour packet capture host and rotate captures to the evidence bucket every 2 hours.

mira (eng-security): Remediation & retest process: we ask for a 48–72 hour FYI after fix submission, then vendor schedules verification. Our target retest window is 7 days after fixes but we can allow earlier if fixes are trivial. Please add fix verification steps to SEC-4892 (include config diffs + commands run and logs showing fix).

alex (platform): For evidence uploads, vendor will use signed URLs; we will provide an upload endpoint. Reminder to redact any PII before upload.

jordan (infosec): Action items: 1) mira — create and own SEC-4892 checklist (in Jira) 2) alex — whitelist IPs + create upload signed URL 3) sam — turn on egress/pcap and export schedule 4) KMS team — ensure HSM test key + CMEK for bucket 5) product — confirm SME availability.

mira (eng-security): I’ll create the checklist and post the onboarding script in the ticket. Also adding required proof-of-fix template: short description, terraform/iam diff, logs showing the exploit no longer reproduces, and an updated risk rating.

anya (product): I’ll be on-call during the remediation window. Also can we schedule a 30m runbook walkthru with the vendor and infra owners tomorrow?

jordan (infosec): Good idea. @alex @sam tomorrow 10am PT for runbook walkthru?

alex (platform): 10am PT works. I’ll DM vendor for the Zoom link and post in SEC-4892.

mira (eng-security): Final note: do not include screenshots of error traces that contain session tokens. If you need to attach logs with sensitive identifiers, redact or provide a scrubbed copy and a separate secure file transfer for raw evidence to infosec-only access.

pen-test-bot: Reminder scheduled: recon window starts 1923460000. Auto-checkpoints set at triage, remediation, retest.

jordan (infosec): Thanks everyone — checklist and ticket owner assigned. I’ll follow up in SEC-4892 with vendor confirmation and final whitelist once done.
